rules.final_decision: Passing supports a replacement research candidate only; no formal champion promotion
rules.intermediate_validation: Diagnostic only; do not select unregistered intermediate steps or alter LR

replication.aggregate_improvement: At least one primary mean delta >= its pooled_seed_std and the same metric has paired-day block 95% interval lower bound > 0
replication.baseline: Rerun 1500 steps with the identical new core source for both additional seeds
replication.failure_action: Keep the 1500-step reference, report failed or inconclusive evidence
replication.risk_gate: Every period-seed pair: each risk metric regression <= its own pooled_seed_std

uncertainty.method: Average seeds within each day; moving two-day blocks within each period

screen.aggregate_improvement: Equal-period mean delta of at least one primary >= its pooled_seed_std
screen.failed_action: Do not expand seeds for a failed budget
screen.risk_gate: In every period, each risk metric regression <= its own pooled_seed_std

selection.eligible: Only budgets passing the complete screen including risk gate
selection.none_pass: Keep the 1500-step reference; stop without seed expansion
selection.priority: Higher equal-period mean RankIC; exact RankIC ties choose fewer steps
selection.replication_limit: Replicate only the selected budget, not both screened budgets
selection.shorter_budget_tie: If absolute differences between eligible budgets are below both primary pooled_seed_std thresholds, select the shorter budget

rules.stopping: Only 1500/5000/10000 screen; stop at declared caps or failures. No extra budgets, LR search, or final-split access. Preserve all attempts and reference weights.
